title: Reel 1 - Orders getting lost in DMs (Advisory)
tts_text: Aap ke DMs mein orders kho rahe hain. [short pause] Customer ne poocha, price kya hai? You replied two hours later. Tab tak, sale gayi. [short pause] Orders DMs, WhatsApp aur calls mein bikhre hain. Nobody knows what's paid, what's pending. [short pause] Fix it in three steps. [short pause] One. An order form. Customer apna naam, address aur item khud bharta hai. [short pause] Two. An auto-reply, so every message gets an answer in seconds. [short pause] Three. One screen jahan har order dikhta hai: pending, paid, delivered. [short pause] Result? No more copy-pasting addresses at midnight. [short pause] Want this for your shop? Comment ORDERS, hum aap ko details bhej denge.
